breakpoint.$description: CONFIRMED BY REAL USAGE (2026-07-23) — no longer just a proposal. Every app today carries 3 separate, conflicting breakpoint systems at once (custom Tailwind screens, SCSS $breakpoint-* vars, CSS custom properties), but a real-usage audit found that regardless of what's configured, developers overwhelmingly already reach for standard Tailwind sm/md/lg/xl/2xl in practice: 217-2,844 real responsive-prefix instances per app (xl: alone hit 2,533 uses in one app), versus just 0-46 instances of the custom mobile375/mobile/mobilesmall/tablet/desktop scheme per app — and those few instances are almost entirely confined to legacy Auth screens, not the current app. Consolidating onto the standard scale isn't a risky migration into unfamiliar territory; it's formalizing what's already the dominant real pattern. tablet:768 already equals md:768 exactly, so nothing is lost. Still needs sign-off before the literal Tailwind config change (updating the handful of legacy Auth-screen classes), but the direction itself is no longer in question.
